name: Battle of Vouillé
summary: Clovis I, King of the Franks, defeats and kills Alaric II, King of the Visigoths, at Vouillé near Poitiers. Clovis, a Catholic Christian, fights as the champion of the Orthodox Church against the Arian Visigoths; Pope Anastasius awards him an honorary consulship. The battle drives the Visigoths from Gaul into Iberia, making the Franks the dominant power in Western Europe and confirming Catholic Christianity as the religion of the emerging Frankish empire.

_quarry.structural_significance: Establishes the Franks as the dominant Germanic power in Western Europe; drives Visigoths into Iberia; confirms Catholic Christianity over Arianism in Gaul; begins the Merovingian period of French history
